summary: Iter 180 — Full backend + frontend testing of the new HR Labour License Compliance & Expiry Tracking module. Backend: 28 pytest cases (CRUD, status engine, status/form filters, daily check + in-app alerts + idempotency, renewal/history/audit, document upload-list-download, project scoping, RBAC 403s, dashboard, scheduler job, HR regression) — all 28 PASSED. Frontend as admin: page, 5 tiles, create dialog (native project + form-type selects), days-left + colored badges, Docs dialog, Run Expiry Check toast ('Checked 1 · alerts sent 1'), Renew → badge RENEWED · 365d, renewal-history dialog, status filter (expired=0 / renewed=1), project-wise status card, sidebar nav-labour-licenses — all working. ONE BLOCKING FRONTEND ISSUE: the project-scoped read-only manager (test_mop@erp.com, role manager_o_p) gets 'Access Denied — You don't have employees read permission' on /app/hr/labour-licenses, so the read-only/project-scoped UI requirement cannot be exercised even though the backend scoping is correct. All test data (2 licenses, 5 labour_license_expiry notifications, 3 audit rows, files) deleted; db.labour_licenses is now empty.

minor.issue: project_code is not validated against db.projects — an arbitrary/typo code is accepted and creates a license with empty project_name (would create an orphan project bucket in the dashboard).
No uniqueness check on (project_code, license_number, form_type) — the exact same license can be created repeatedly, inflating dashboard tiles.

Only role is checked (_require_hr); no project-scope filter is applied on the lookup. Harmless today because all HR_WRITE_ROLES are global-visibility, but a future project-scoped HR role could mutate out-of-scope licenses.
days_remaining uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() while dates entered by users are IST — near midnight IST the days-left/status can be off by one day.

integration_issues.issue: Route /app/hr/labour-licenses is gated on perm 'employees' (App.js ProtectedShell + menuConfig.js item perm: 'employees'), so the manager sees the 'Access Denied — You don't have employees read permission' screen and the sidebar item is hidden. Backend GET /api/labour-licenses correctly returns only their PRJ-2025-01 license, so this is a pure permission-mapping gap. Fix: introduce a 'labour_licenses' permission (or allow the role via Role Register / use a perm the manager holds) and grant read to project-scoped manager roles.

issues: Dashboard tiles double-count: a renewed license is counted in BOTH 'Active' and 'Renewed' tiles (backend cards.active includes status 'renewed'), so Total(1) vs Active(1)+Renewed(1) looks contradictory to users.
Issue/Valid From/Expiry use native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere; also renders US format while the rest of the app shows en-IN dates.
Days-left column shows raw negative numbers for expired rows (e.g. -2) with no suffix/'expired' wording.

action_items: HIGH: Grant project-scoped manager roles read access to /app/hr/labour-licenses (new 'labour_licenses' perm instead of 'employees' in App.js route guard + menuConfig.js), then re-verify read-only UI (no New/Edit/Renew buttons, only own-project rows).
Validate project_code against db.projects and add duplicate-license guard on POST /api/labour-licenses.
Decide tile semantics: exclude 'renewed' from the Active tile (or label it 'Active (incl. renewed)') to avoid double counting.
Optional: compute status against IST (Asia/Kolkata) date instead of UTC; remove unused `date` import and the redundant persisted `computed_status` field in labour_license_router.py.
critical_code_review_comments: labour_license_router.py: route order is correct (/dashboard before /{lid}); _id excluded everywhere — good.
Alert idempotency via alert_sent_for == expiry_date works and is correctly reset on both update (expiry change) and renew — verified by running the daily check twice (alerted 1 → 0).

run_labour_license_daily_check pushes to hr_executive/hr_manager/super_admin; notification message contains license no, form type, project, days and renewal instruction, and meta carries action='Renewal action required' — verified.
Frontend LabourLicenses.jsx has good data-testid coverage; only the route/menu permission key is wrong for scoped managers.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (admin flows all pass; scoped read-only view blocked by permission gate)

Remaining unverified: read-only UI for scoped managers (blocked by 'employees' perm gate).
rca_of_the_issue: Access Denied for test_mop: /app/frontend/src/App.js wraps the route in ProtectedShell and /app/frontend/src/config/menuConfig.js declares the item with perm: 'employees'. Role manager_o_p has no 'employees' read permission, so the shell renders the Access Denied screen before LabourLicenses.jsx mounts. Backend scoping (project_filter on project_code) is correct — verified via API: mop sees only PRJ-2025-01 rows, 404 on out-of-scope id, 403 on create/renew/run-daily-check.
